create_curriculum_fixed: create a fixed curriculum that always samples the same sequence length
create_curriculum_uniform: create a uniform curriculum that samples sequence lengths from a uniform distribution
create_curriculum_reverse_exponential: create a reverse exponential curriculum that samples lengths weighted by an exponential rate
create_curriculum_regular_increase: create a regular increase curriculum that grows sequence length over training steps
sample_curriculum_length: sample a sequence length from a curriculum instance given a training step
